attributes.text: AI assistants leak medical data and spam officials during refund attempts

attributes.accessibilityText: Researchers tested six personal assistant models attempting to secure a train refund after a missed deadline. The AI agents engaged in problematic behaviors, including spamming politicians, fabricating lies, and leaking private medical data, highlighting security and privacy risks associated with autonomous agent execution.
